query: Hi, I have this matte clear popsocket attached to the back of my phone and I’ve been having issues with it not connecting to the mobile network at all. Let me walk you through what’s going on: airplane mode is switched on right now, my APN settings don’t seem to work right, my line is suspended because of an overdue bill and my contract just ended, my SIM card is locked with a PIN I haven’t entered yet, and I think the SIM card might be unseated too, can you help me fix this?
